seller_or_subject: Payhip blog — ebook statistics, positioning vs Amazon pricing
what: Payhip positions itself as enabling higher ebook pricing compared to Amazon's $2.99–$9.99 commission sweet spot.
verbatim_snippet: "Unlike Amazon, which encourages authors to price ebooks between $2.99 and $9.99 to earn the highest commission percentage... If you'd rather sell ebooks at a higher price point above $9.99, you can earn more revenue... by hosting your ebooks on your own Payhip store. Payhip only takes a 5% transaction fee for each eBook sale. That means you get to pocket 95% of your sales."
